| `place_order`, `cancel_order`, `get_order_details`, `get_order_history` | Full order lifecycle support |
| `fund_account`, `withdraw_funds`, `get_account_info` | Cash flow & portfolio overview |
| `notify_price_change` | Alert when a ticker moves beyond a % threshold |
